reviews.quote: Perfect for chilly days at home or even decks, keeps warm on cold rock or tile floors
My toddler started to try putting on my Bombas slippers, so I decided to get him some of his own. They’re so cute and cozy and easy to put on. No more cold toes!

My good friend swears by her Bombas, so I wanted to give them a try. I bought myself these for Christmas and the heels were already wearing through by following February. The comfort was disappointing for the price. I would definitely not recommend these for hard wood floors--the sole is too thin (but the grip was great!).

Let me start by saying I do love your socks, with that said i can tell you that i was very disappointed in the slippers i bought. They are not warm at all, i live in an old hose so i by slippers that have sticky bottoms and have some substance too them. I have a pair of Walmart bootie socks that i bought for 15 bucks that are warmer than your 70 dollar slippers.

Not at all happy with these booties. Would like a resolution on this. Please advise. Thank you. Anita
